requirementSummary: 12 electives: CSE List A (1), CSE List C (1), natural science (3), technical (4), communication (1), unrestricted (2).
Technical electives: one List 1, one List 2, and two additional courses from Lists 1–3; not before 3A.
One sustainability course may overlap another elective.
Five PD courses: PD 10, PD 11, PD 19, PD 20 and one additional PD course.
